title: Wogi Flow Configuration
description: Configuration for Wogi Flow AI workflow methodology v1.9+

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

projectName.description: Name of the project for display purposes

autoUpdateAppMap.description: Automatically update app-map.md when components change

requireApproval.description: List of operations requiring user approval

type.description: CLI type for this project (only claude-code is supported)

autoSync.description: Auto-sync settings for CLI instruction files

enabled.description: Enable auto-sync of CLI instruction files

onSessionStart.description: Auto-sync on session start if files are missing or stale

enforcement.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Task gating and strict mode settings

strictMode.description: Enable strict task gating - requires task before any implementation

requireTaskForImplementation.description: Require an active task before writing code

requireStoryForMediumTasks.description: Require story with acceptance criteria for medium+ tasks

requirePatternCitation.description: Require citing patterns from decisions.md in code comments

citationFormat.description: Format for pattern citations in code

blockAutoTask.description: Block edits even if auto-task was created. When true, only tasks started via /wogi-start are valid.

warnOnBypass.description: Display warnings when workflow bypasses are detected (auto-created tasks, missing /wogi-start)

planMode.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Plan Mode settings inspired by Claude Code's safe analysis approach

explorePhase.description: Read-only exploration phase before spec generation

enabled.description: Enable Explore Phase for medium/large tasks

minTaskLevel.description: Minimum task level to trigger Explore Phase (L0=Epic, L1=Story, L2=Task, L3=Subtask)

enabled.description: Enable Explicit Approval Gate for medium/large tasks

minTaskLevel.description: Minimum task level to require approval (L0=Epic, L1=Story, L2=Task, L3=Subtask)

workflow.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - High-level workflow configuration

loops.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Self-completing execution loop settings

enforced.description: Enforce loop completion before task close

requireVerification.description: Require verification pass for each scenario

blockOnSkip.description: Block if any scenario is skipped

maxRetries.description: Max retries per scenario before failure

pauseBetweenScenarios.description: Pause and wait for user between scenarios

autoInferVerification.description: Auto-generate verification steps from acceptance criteria

fallbackToManual.description: Fall back to manual verification if auto fails

suggestBrowserTests.description: Suggest browser tests for UI-related tasks

simpleMode.description: Simple Mode - lightweight loop without formal acceptance criteria

enabled.description: Enable Simple Mode for quick tasks

completionPromise.description: String pattern that signals loop completion

recheckAllAfterFix.description: Re-verify ALL acceptance criteria after fixing ANY criterion (regression protection)

regressionOnRecheck.description: Action when regression is detected during re-check

durableSteps.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Crash recovery and session persistence

autoResume.description: Auto-resume interrupted tasks on session start

checkSuspensionsOnStart.description: Check for suspended tasks on session start

defaultMaxAttempts.description: Default max retry attempts for durable steps

suspension.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Long-running task suspension settings

reminderAfterHours.description: Hours before sending reminder about suspended task

parallel.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Concurrent task execution settings

requireWorktree.description: Require git worktree isolation for parallel

showProgress.description: Show progress indicators for parallel tasks

minTasksForParallel.description: Minimum tasks to suggest parallel mode

bulkOrchestrator.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Bulk task orchestration with sub-agent isolation

enabled.description: Enable orchestrator mode for /wogi-bulk (each task in fresh context)

parallelLimit.description: Maximum tasks to run in parallel per batch

useWorktrees.description: Use git worktrees for parallel task isolation

enabled.description: Keep checking for new tasks after queue is empty

idleTimeout.description: Seconds to wait before checking for new tasks

phases.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Project phase tracking

mandatorySteps.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Required steps at various points

afterTask.description: Steps to run after each task completion

beforeCommit.description: Steps to run before each commit

onSessionEnd.description: Steps to run when session ends

priorities.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Task priority configuration

storyDecomposition.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Story breakdown settings

loadingStates.description: Include loading states in UI tasks

qualityGates.description: CATEGORY: QUALITY & VALIDATION - Per-task-type quality requirements

validation.description: CATEGORY: QUALITY & VALIDATION - Auto-validation command settings

enabled.description: Run validation after each file edit

fixErrorsBeforeContinuing.description: Block further edits until errors fixed

testing.description: CATEGORY: QUALITY & VALIDATION - Test execution settings

regressionTesting.description: CATEGORY: QUALITY & VALIDATION - Regression test settings

sampleSize.description: Number of random tasks to test

runOnTaskComplete.description: Run regression tests after each task

browserTesting.description: CATEGORY: QUALITY & VALIDATION - Browser test integration

capture.description: CATEGORY: CAPTURE - Quick capture configuration with auto-grouping

autoGroup.description: Automatically group related captured items together

groupingThreshold.description: Similarity threshold for grouping (0-1, higher = stricter)

maxGroupSize.description: Maximum number of items in a single group

routing.description: Routing configuration for certain vs uncertain ideas

enabled.description: Enable routing (certain → roadmap, uncertain → discussion queue)

componentRules.description: CATEGORY: QUALITY & VALIDATION - Component reuse and creation rules

preferVariants.description: Prefer adding variants over creating new components

requireAppMapEntry.description: Require app-map entry for new components

strictMode.description: CATEGORY: QUALITY & VALIDATION - Additional strict mode options

skillGeneration.description: CATEGORY: SKILLS - Skill generation sources and context overflow prevention

fetchMode.description: Sequential prevents context overflow; parallel is faster but risky

compactThreshold.description: Suggest compaction when context exceeds this %

skillLearning.description: CATEGORY: LEARNING & MEMORY - Skill auto-creation and learning

fetchOfficialDocs.description: Fetch official documentation for detected frameworks

learnFromLoopRetries.description: Enable learning from tasks that take >3 iterations. Analyzes root causes and suggests pattern updates.

loopRetryThreshold.description: Number of iterations before triggering loop retry learning analysis

autoSuggestPatternUpdates.description: Automatically suggest updates to decisions.md based on loop retry learnings

memory.description: CATEGORY: LEARNING & MEMORY - Fact storage configuration

automaticMemory.description: CATEGORY: LEARNING & MEMORY - Automatic memory management

automaticPromotion.description: CATEGORY: LEARNING & MEMORY - Pattern promotion to persistent storage

modelAdapters.description: CATEGORY: LEARNING & MEMORY - Per-model learning adapters

prd.description: CATEGORY: LEARNING & MEMORY - PRD (Product Requirements Document) handling

autoContext.description: CATEGORY: CONTEXT & SESSION - Auto-loading related files

searchTimeout.description: Search timeout in milliseconds. Before Claude Code 2.1.23, search timeouts returned empty results silently.

retryOnTimeout.description: Retry search with reduced scope on timeout

warnOnEmptyResults.description: Log warning when search returns unexpectedly empty (may indicate timeout)

maxContentLines.description: Maximum lines per file to include

useAstGrep.description: Use AST-based grep for better matches

maxSemanticFacts.description: Max semantic memory facts to include

lspEnrichment.description: LSP enrichment settings for type info

sessionState.description: CATEGORY: CONTEXT & SESSION - Session persistence settings

maxGapHours.description: Max hours gap to consider same session

contextMonitor.description: CATEGORY: CONTEXT & SESSION - Context window monitoring

morningBriefing.description: CATEGORY: CONTEXT & SESSION - Session start briefing

showRecommendedTasks.description: Number of recommended tasks to show

requestLog.description: CATEGORY: CONTEXT & SESSION - Change history logging

guidedEdit.description: CATEGORY: DEVELOPMENT TOOLS - Step-by-step multi-file editing

traces.description: CATEGORY: DEVELOPMENT TOOLS - Code flow trace configuration

worktree.description: CATEGORY: DEVELOPMENT TOOLS - Git worktree isolation

hybrid.description: CATEGORY: DEVELOPMENT TOOLS - Local LLM execution (85-95% token savings)

lsp.description: CATEGORY: DEVELOPMENT TOOLS - Language server integration

commits.description: CATEGORY: SAFETY & COMMITS - Commit approval workflow

requireApproval.description: Which task types require commit approval

security.description: CATEGORY: SAFETY & COMMITS - Pre-commit security scanning

scanBeforeCommit.description: Scan for security issues before commit

blockOnHigh.description: Block commit on high severity issues

ignoreFiles.description: Files to ignore in security scans

damageControl.description: CATEGORY: SAFETY & COMMITS - Destructive command protection

events.description: Which event types to check for damage control rules

prompt.description: Check user prompts for destructive patterns

taskGating.description: Block edits without an active task

blockWithoutTask.description: Block file edits if no task is active

autoCreateTask.description: Auto-create a quick task when editing without one. When false, edits are blocked entirely without /wogi-start.

loopEnforcement.description: Block stop until acceptance criteria met

spinnerVerbs.description: Customize the action verbs displayed in the spinner while Claude is working (requires Claude Code 2.1.23+). Provide an array of verb strings.

spinnerTipsEnabled.description: Show tips in the spinner while Claude is working

workflowSteps.description: CATEGORY: TASK & WORKFLOW - Configurable plug-in steps that run at various points in task execution. Enable/disable steps via config or interactive setup.

triggerFor.description: File patterns that trigger this step (e.g., ['*.tsx', '*.jsx'])

regressionTest.description: Test random completed tasks to catch regressions. Uses flow-regression.js under the hood.

sampleSize.description: Number of random tasks to test

browserTest.description: Suggest browser tests for UI changes. Checks .workflow/tests/flows/ for test definitions.

triggerFor.description: File extensions that trigger browser tests

securityScan.description: Run npm audit and check for secrets in code. Blocks on high/critical vulnerabilities by default.

alwaysAudit.description: Run npm audit even if package.json wasn't modified

updateKnowledgeBase.description: Prompt to document learnings in .claude/docs/knowledge-base/. Detects patterns, hooks, APIs, and config changes.

updateChangelog.description: Add entries to CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog format. Auto-categorizes as Added/Fixed/Changed.

codeComplexityCheck.description: Analyze cyclomatic complexity of modified functions. Flags functions exceeding threshold.

coverageCheck.description: Verify test coverage meets threshold. Supports Jest, Vitest, NYC/Istanbul.

checkModifiedOnly.description: Only check coverage for modified files

runTests.description: Run tests if no coverage data exists

codeSimplifier.description: AI-powered qualitative code simplification suggestions. Analyzes nesting, function length, complexity patterns.

maxFunctionLines.description: Max lines per function before flagging

codeReview.description: Hybrid code review: multi-agent for large/high-risk files, simple for small changes.

multiAgentThreshold.description: File count threshold for multi-agent review

prTestAnalyzer.description: Analyze test coverage and quality for modified files.

silentFailureHunter.description: Detect empty catch blocks, swallowed errors, and unhandled async.

checkLogOnlyCatch.description: Check for catch blocks that only log

commentAnalyzer.description: Analyze comment quality: TODOs, stale comments, JSDoc accuracy.
